worldcombat.skill.payback.summary: Steps in and strikes back: the blow doubles when the target already moved inside the window, and it lands heavier the more health the user has lost.
worldcombat.skill.payback.use.0: Answer a hit with a heavier one
worldcombat.skill.payback.description.0: Deals about %1$s physical damage; if the target struck the user within the last %2$s seconds (or is swinging at the user right now), the blow's power doubles.
worldcombat.skill.payback.description.1: Steps in up to %1$s blocks to strike back, advancing %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block collision radius, and stops early if terrain blocks the way. On hit it knocks the target back %4$s blocks; the more health the user has lost, the more extra power is folded in at a %5$s grievance coefficient.
worldcombat.skill.payback.patient.on: Patient stance on: the window is 0.8 s longer and the grievance coefficient rises 40 to 55, so the blow is heavier while wounded; costs 3 ticks more prepare and 6 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.payback.patient.off: Patient stance off: quicker to answer with a shorter window, doubling only when the foe swings point blank.
worldcombat.skill.payback.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.payback.growth.0: At level %1$s the counter power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.payback.growth.1: At level %1$s the counter power rises to %2$s and the step-in distance to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.payback.preference.pat: On: the reckoning window is 0.8 s longer and the grievance coefficient rises 40 to 55, so the blow is heavier while wounded, but prepare takes 3 ticks and cooldown 6 ticks more. Off: quicker to answer with a shorter window, doubling only when the foe swings point blank.
Only step in against threats this close; a larger value chases a punishable target further.
On: a foe that just struck the user or is swinging at the user is prioritized for the counter (exactly the doubling window). Off: sorted like an ordinary melee attack.
